root_cause.text: `vsock_update_buffer_size()` in `net/vmw_vsock/af_vsock.c` applied the buffer-size clamps in the wrong order, so a too-large `vsk->buffer_min_size` could override the max clamp and let `vsk->buffer_size` exceed `vsk->buffer_max_size`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the minimum check before the maximum check, and the CVE description explicitly says that when “a user sets a minimum buffer size larger than the maximum, the minimum check overrides the maximum check, inverting the constraint” and allowing `vsk->buffer_size` to grow beyond `vsk->buffer_max_size`.
